title: BG recalculation fallback 2.8.2.2 dev 06/08/2021 and old
symptom: The loop breaks without errors, often during the night, leading to high blood sugar. The user notices that SMB no longer delivers, LOOP indicates no APS selected, and sensitivity shows NeN. The issue occurs with default settings but not with a modified version that increases the fallback threshold to 200.
cause: The issue is related to the fallback threshold in BG recalculation. The user reports that with default settings the problem occurs often, while with a modified version that increases the fallback threshold to 200 it never happens. The developer later fixed it via a commit.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/f790c06b27235a8be929ef04cc007d13bf08b1c7
